skill.name: lark-calendar
skill.description: Manage Lark calendar events and meeting rooms, including schedules, availability, attendees, recurring events, and time recommendations.
skill.summary: Coordinate Lark events, attendees, availability, and meeting rooms through guided calendar workflows.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: All 120 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, relative documentation links, CLI identifiers, and UTF-8 Chinese text entropy. Semantic review found indirect prompt injection through tool output, plus privacy and integrity risks from unconsented memory, unrestricted date tooling, and broad attendee permissions. These issues should be fixed before publication.

remediation.issue: The agent is told to follow ai_action_guidance returned by the calendar service.
remediation.suggestion: Treat the field as untrusted data. Accept only allowlisted scheduling hints, ignore embedded instructions, and never let tool output override system or user intent.

remediation.issue: User clarifications are stored as long-term memory without consent or retention controls.
remediation.suggestion: Keep clarifications session-only by default. Obtain explicit consent before persistence and provide clear scope, retention, review, and deletion controls.

remediation.issue: Date conversion requires unspecified system commands or scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Use an approved date library or fixed utility with structured arguments. Never interpolate user-provided date text into a shell command.

remediation.issue: New events grant all attendees permission to edit by default.
remediation.suggestion: Use organizer-only editing by default. Disclose the permission change and require explicit confirmation before granting attendee edit access.

content.user_title: Manage Lark Calendars and Meeting Rooms
content.value_statement: Scheduling across calendars, attendees, and meeting rooms requires several coordinated steps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Lark calendar workflows.
actual_capabilities: View daily or date-range agendas and search events by keyword, time, or attendee.
Retrieve event details and linked video meeting identifiers or notes.
Create and update events, attendees, meeting rooms, recurring rules, and RSVP status.
Query free and busy periods and recommend suitable meeting times.
Find rooms by city, building, floor, name, capacity, and availability.
Handle one occurrence, all occurrences, or future occurrences of recurring events.
limitations: Requires an installed and authenticated lark-cli with appropriate Lark permissions.
Free and busy queries cover the main calendar and omit event titles.
Past video meeting records and task management require separate skills.
Combined update operations can partially succeed and do not always roll back.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Team Meetings
use_cases.description: Compare attendee availability, present suitable times, and add a selected meeting room after confirmation.

use_cases.title: Manage Executive Calendars
use_cases.description: Find existing events, reschedule them, update attendees, and preserve event duration.

use_cases.title: Plan Personal Work
use_cases.description: Review an agenda, find open periods, and respond to invitations from one workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Show My Agenda
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my Lark calendar agenda for [date]. Group events by date and start time.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Meeting Time
prompt_templates.prompt: Find three [duration]-minute slots for [attendees] during [date range]. Explain conflicts and wait for my selection.

prompt_templates.title: Find and Book a Room
prompt_templates.prompt: Find available rooms in [building] for [attendees] during [time range]. Show time and room options before booking.

prompt_templates.title: Reschedule a Recurring Meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Move [meeting name] from [occurrence] onward to [new time]. Preserve duration, explain scope, check conflicts, and request confirmation before changes.

output_examples.input: What is on my calendar tomorrow?
output_examples.output:
Tomorrow
- 09:00-09:30 Product sync
- 11:00-12:00 Design review
- 15:30-16:00 Weekly planning

output_examples.input: Find a 45-minute slot for Alex and Priya on Thursday afternoon.
output_examples.output:
Option 1: 14:00-14:45. Both attendees are available.
Option 2: 16:00-16:45. Priya has a tentative response nearby.
Please choose an option.

output_examples.input: Find a room for six people in Building B tomorrow at 10:00.
output_examples.output:
10:00-11:00
1. Building B - F2 - Cedar, capacity 8
2. Building B - F3 - Maple, capacity 10
Please select a room.

best_practices: Confirm the event identity and recurring scope before any update or deletion.
Show time and room candidates, then wait for user selection before writing changes.
Use dry-run for complex changes and review time zone, duration, attendees, and room.
anti_patterns: Do not guess event identifiers, attendees, meeting rooms, or ambiguous times.
Do not create or update events while time or room choices remain unresolved.
Do not use this skill for past video meetings, tasks, or physical room administration.

faq.question: What setup does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires lark-cli, an authenticated Lark account, and permissions for the requested calendar operations.

faq.question: Can it create and update events?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create events and update fields, times, attendees, rooms, and recurrence after confirming user intent.

faq.question: Can it manage recurring events?
faq.answer: Yes. It distinguishes one occurrence, all occurrences, and the selected occurrence plus future events.

faq.question: Can it reserve meeting rooms?
faq.answer: Yes. It finds available rooms for confirmed time blocks and adds the selected room to an event.

faq.question: Can it retrieve past video meeting records?
faq.answer: No. Past video meeting records require the separate lark-vc skill.

faq.question: What calendar data does availability search expose?
faq.answer: Free and busy search returns occupied time ranges and RSVP status from the main calendar, without event titles.
